REPORT
Date August 15, 19 38.

Subject H. F. K. HULSEMANN - Communication dated July 19, 1938 from
Burma Defence Bureau.
Made by D. S. Pitts    Forwarded by Wogan.

Hugo Friedrich Kurt HULSEMANN, German, was born
in Magdeburg, Berlin in 1902 of wealthy parents of good
background and reputation. He received an extensive
education, terminating his studies in 1931 at the University
of Hamburg where he was successful in securing the degree of
a Doctor in Philosophy. Since that time, however, he has
devoted himself to the study of the science of races, their
relations to one another and their characteristics and is
well known in Germany as a leading ethnologist.

His trip around the world, which has already taken
him to numerous countries, was undertaken with the purpose
of increasing his knowledge of ethnology, although it should
be added that his interest in this direction is primarily
in people as they live to-day rather than in their origins
and earlier developments.

A brilliant man in many respects and having all the
attributes of a gentleman born and bred, Dr. Hulsemann is
looked upon in certain responsible circles as a person given
to eccentricities and, at times, whimsical fads, resulting in
his having been regarded on numerous occasions as either a
suspicious character or an individual whose mental make-up
was decidedly unbalanced.

Prior to arriving in Shanghai on July 11, 1938 he
stayed in Japan for some three months, studying the peasant
and farmer classes there to gain material for his research
work. He was in the habit of making his way from one point
to another on foot, asking questions here and there and making
notes on various interesting features. Since he never was

雨果·弗里德里希·库尔特·胡尔塞曼（Hugo Friedrich Kurt HULSEMANN），德国人，1902年出生于柏林马格德堡（Magdeburg, Berlin），父母家境富裕，背景良好，声誉卓著。他受过广泛的教育，于1931年在汉堡大学完成学业，并成功获得哲学博士学位。然而，自那时起，他便致力于种族科学的研究，探讨种族间的相互关系及其特征，在德国作为一位著名的人种学家而广为人知。

他的环球旅行已带他去过许多国家，其目的是增加他的人种学知识，尽管需要补充的是，他在这方面的兴趣主要在于人们当今的生活状态，而非他们的起源和早期发展。

胡尔塞曼博士在许多方面才华横溢，具备天生绅士的所有特质，但在某些负责圈子里，他被视为一个行为古怪、有时沉迷于异想天开的癖好的人，导致他多次被视为可疑人物，或被认为精神结构明显失衡的个人。

在1938年7月11日抵达上海之前，他在日本停留了约三个月，研究那里的农民和农夫阶层，以为其研究工作收集材料。他习惯于步行从一个地点到另一个地点，四处询问，并对各种有趣的特征做笔记。由于他从未

clad in more than a pair of shoes, shorts and a shirt ( often
the latter was missing ), since he never indulged in shaving
but grew a great shaggy beard and since he always stayed the
night in practically the meanest hovel he could find, he
eventually drew the attentions of the Japanese Police towards
himself and in the early part of July, 1935, was arrested
in Nagasaki as a suspicious character. He was subsequently
released after the German Consulate-General in that town
had intervened and established his real identity.

In Shanghai he stayed at the German Home ( now
defunct ), a place which, in the ordinary run of events,
catered for German down-and-outs and stranded seamen.
Nothing objectionable was noted in his conduct during his
stay here. He remained here for a few months, but finally
intimated that Shanghai was far too cosmopolitan a city for
his studying purposes.

He travels and lives as cheaply as he possibly
can, for he says, "it is only by moving among the poorer
people that one can really understand the traits of the
poor and after all is said and done, they form the greater
part of the populations of the various races."

Dr. Hulsemann would appear to be a man who really
is only interested in the essential things of life, money
and luxury having very little appeal to him.

It is reported, however, that when he does finally
return to Germany, he will publish a volume based upon his
experiences as an ethnologist bolstered by the notes and
details he has recorded during the past few years.

穿过不止一双鞋、短裤和一件衬衫（通常连衬衫都没有），由于他从不刮胡子，而是留着浓密蓬乱的胡须，且由于他总是宿在他能找到的最简陋的棚屋里，他最终引起了日本警方的注意，并于1935年7月初在长崎作为可疑人物被捕。随后，在该镇的德国总领事馆介入并查明其真实身份后，他被释放。

在上海，他住在德国水手之家（German Home，现已关闭），这是一个通常收容德国落魄者和滞留海员的地方。在此期间，他的行为未发现任何不当之处。他在此停留了几个月，但最后表示，上海对于他的研究目的来说，国际化色彩太浓。

他尽可能廉价地旅行和生活，因为他说，“只有混迹于穷人之中，才能真正了解穷人的特质，毕竟归根结底，他们构成了各种族人口的大部分。”

胡尔塞曼博士似乎是一个只对生活中本质事物感兴趣的人，金钱和奢华对他几乎没有吸引力。

然而，据报道，当他最终返回德国时，他将出版一卷基于其作为人种学家经历的书，并以过去几年记录的笔记和细节为佐证。

STATEMENT OF DR.PHIL HUGO FRIEDRICH KURT HULSEMANN.
**〔此处转录不清：右上角手写数字及污损〕**

I am a German subject, having been born at
Magdeburg, Berlin, Germany. I am 32 years of age and
a Doctor of Philosophy. I came out from home on tour.
I am a journalist by profession, but I am not connected
with any particular newspaper. Sometime I give articles
to the newspaper containing my adventures and experiences.
I am the master of eight European languages. After
staying for a few months in Shanghai in 1935, I came
over to Siam where I had worked as an English teacher
and thus earned some money. Later on I took up tuition
and remained there for some time.

Then I crossed the Siamese border and entered
Victoria Point on the 17th. December 1937. I lived
there with one Mrs. Snow, a teacher, living opposite
the Customs House, Victoria Point. Having stayed there
for about six months, I left for Rangoon by the s.s.
"Juna" and arrived here on the 12th. July 1938.

I hold German passport No.380, issued at
Shanghai on the 30th. September 1935, bearing British
visa No.35002, granted at Manila on 7th. April 1937. I
am in possession of 70/- American Dollars and Rs.10/-
(Indian currency). I may go back to Siam after a few
months. On my return home I have a mind to compile a
book of my experience touching customs and languages of
the people of the East.

"True Copy"
**〔此处转录不清：签名及日期 19/7〕**
Office of the Director, Burma Defence Bureau, Rangoon.
pages.zh:
哲学博士雨果·弗里德里希·库尔特·胡尔塞曼的陈述。
**〔此处转录不清：右上角手写数字及污损〕**

我是德国臣民，出生于德国柏林马格德堡。我今年32岁，拥有哲学博士学位。我离家进行巡回考察。我的职业是记者，但我并不隶属于任何特定的报社。有时我会向报纸投稿，刊登我的冒险和经历。我精通八种欧洲语言。1935年在上海停留几个月后，我前往暹罗，在那里担任英语教师，从而赚取了一些钱。后来我从事家教工作，并在那里停留了一段时间。

随后，我越过暹罗边境，于1937年12月17日进入维多利亚角（Victoria Point）。我住在那里的一位名叫斯诺（Snow）的女教师家中，她住在维多利亚角海关对面。在那里住了大约六个月后，我乘坐“朱纳”号轮船（s.s. "Juna"）前往仰光，并于1938年7月12日抵达此地。

我持有1935年9月30日在上海签发的第380号德国护照，上面有1937年4月7日在马尼拉签发的第35002号英国签证。我手头有70美元和10卢比（印度货币）。几个月后我可能会返回暹罗。在回国时，我打算编纂一本关于东方人民风俗和语言的亲身经历之书。

“真实副本”
**〔此处转录不清：签名及日期 19/7〕**
缅甸防卫局局长办公室，仰光。
